card.name: Linking words inside step-by-step instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation, or the word Step inside procedural instructions, right where one action ends and the next step begins. Common in recipes, skin-care directions and preparation instructions.

modes.label: Between actions in recipes
modes.description: A word or period after a short command, just before the next cooking action.
modes.example: Remove<< and>> keep warm. Add the beans, corn

modes.label: Between prep or application actions
modes.description: A linking word in drug preparation or skin-care directions, before the next action.
modes.example: Treat the vial stoppers with the antiseptic wipe and allow<< to>> dry.

modes.label: References to a numbered step
modes.description: The word in or Step when pointing back to an earlier numbered step.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing step or steps, as in a reference to a numbered step or the next step.
card.plain: It fires in how-to instructions where one action ends and the next step is about to start.
